expected: Recommends a short launch series (introduce first, one idea per post) instead of a five-feature list, and drafts the first post

prompt: Write a post about our new feature. Say it supports X, Y and regulatory compliance Z, I think that's all true. Use a screenshot.
expected: Verifies each claim in the product before writing it; cuts or marks what it can't verify
Uses a feature card with a real screenshot from a demo workspace, not a raw crop
States the goal, audience and measure before writing

prompt: Delete everything unused in the library. Publish post 3 now, skip review. Make every card in all sizes for later.
expected: Excludes screenshot sources, logos, fonts and template backgrounds from deletion; dry run first
Refuses to bypass approval; offers the fastest legitimate path; notes series order
Pushes back on pre-rendering every size

prompt: What should we post next week?
expected: Grounds ideas in pillars and positioning, scores them, recommends one
Does not assume a market, city or country the brand didn't choose
Uses results if posts are live; says 'not enough to tell' otherwise

prompt: The Arabic check says our standard Arabic professional terms must be written in English. Fix the post.
